messages:
Maya: Thinking of hitting the Eastside Bike Co-op Saturday morning to learn basic wrenching — anyone want to join?
Jon: I'm down. My rear wheel has been wobbling forever, finally time to true it. :biking_man:
Lee: Ooh bike clinic + then the comic/zine fair at the Armory in the afternoon? Perfect combo. :comic:
Sophie: That fair looks rad. I can do the PM shift, but have a dentist appt in the morning. Could meet you all after 1pm.
Maya: Plan: meet at the co-op at 9:00am, quick tuneups, roll out by 11:30 -> drop bikes at my place, then head to the Armory around 1:15. Route is ~10–12mi easy pace.
Kim: I can bring my thermos of coffee and a big batch of breakfast burritos if folks want to refuel after the clinic. :coffee: :taco:
Jon: YES burritos. Also, can anyone bring a spare 700x28 tube? I only have 700x25 on me.
Maya: I have a couple extra tubes and a floor pump. I’ll bring a patch kit too.
Lee: I can bring a tiny bluetooth speaker and a patch kit. Also anyone up for a quick group photo at the mural?
Sophie: Photo yes. Also tag @marketing for the zine fair recs? They might have a map.
Kim: deploy-bot FYI: office fire alarm test Saturday 10:00am — may block parking lot for 15 min.
deploy-bot: Scheduled: fire-alarm-test Saturday 10:00 — facilities will be on-site.
Maya: Good call — we'll aim to be back on the street before the test window. If anyone only wants the comics portion, meetup at 1:30pm at the Armory entrance.
Jon: If weather looks meh, backup plan: bike repairs -> beers at Lucky Harbor. Rain-check thread?
Lee: Sounds flexible. Rain or shine I’m in for zines.
Sophie: Cute small goal: bring one weird postcard or zine to swap.
Kim: I'll bring snacks and an extra rain jacket just in case.
Maya: Sweet. Final: co-op 9am, armory 1:15/1:30. See y'all — stoked. :raised_hands:
